day_shape: 59 items: Iran's PGSA declared Strait of Hormuz transit 'not possible' while CENTCOM countered the strait is open, Defa Press claimed a US cruise missile downed near Khorramabad, heavy regime funeral/vengeance messaging for a 'martyred leader', and IDF strikes reported in Gaza City and southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz closure dispute
threads.summary: Iran's Ports and Maritime body and IRIB said transit through the Strait of Hormuz is 'currently not possible' due to US military activity, with a parliamentarian saying management will follow Iranian arrangements. CENTCOM and Trump countered that the strait remains open, with US forces positioned to ensure freedom of navigation; Iran and Oman also held talks on maritime arrangements.

threads.label: Iran-US exchange claims around ceasefire
threads.summary: Defa Press claimed Iran's armed forces struck US bases in response to CENTCOM aggressions and that an IRGC air defence system downed a cruise missile near Khorramabad, and alleged Jordanian complicity via Muwaffaq Salti airbase. Iran's acting Defence Minister Majid Ibn al Reza claimed drone production capacity tripled during the war, and a martyr's son told VICE News that US bases and warships are legitimate targets.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral and vengeance messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted two messages tied to the funeral of 'Iran's martyred leader' on 18 Tir 1405, one demanding vengeance against named 'criminals'. Defa Press and IRIB carried IRGC commander Rezaei's claim that the funeral 'changed regional equations', plans for a documentary, and Iran International reported pro-government rallies were told to continue until Mojtaba Khamenei orders otherwise.

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said airstrikes hit a makeshift weapons production site in Gaza City and announced two Hamas operatives, Hassan Mustafa Zahir Al-Razina and Mohammad Mahmoud Abd al-Mu'ti Fayyoumi, were killed in separate strikes. Regime channels reported Israeli artillery and drone strikes on Kafr Tbnit in Nabatiyeh and the Bekaa, while the IDF publicised a fortified Hezbollah anti-tank position uncovered in Lebanon.

threads.label: Lindsey Graham death reactions
threads.summary: Defa Press reported the death of US Senator Lindsey Graham at 71 on Saturday 11 July, describing him as an 'Iran-hostile' warmonger. Iran International and the Jerusalem Post reported Prince Reza Pahlavi and other Iranian opposition figures called Graham a 'steadfast friend of the Iranian people'.
